title: Mochizuki Honami — Happy Birthday! 2023〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hehe... It's so nice to have everyone here celebrating together.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Behold, Honami! I will now present you with a show—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsu-Tsukasa, what are you doing?! Not yet!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, we all got you a present each.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was a lot of fun secretly going out to buy them with Shiho and the others.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see... I didn't even notice you were planning all of that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hurray! Our surprise was a success♪ Okay, then me first! Here you are!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Is this an apron? The design is so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. Isn't it? I was thinking that this apron might boost your mood when you're cooking!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Saki! I'll be sure to make good use of this! If I bake any sweets, I'll bring them to practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I got you this dish-and-mug set... Mainly because it resembled Shibao.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right! It looks exactly like Shibao! Hehe, I bet he'd jump in shock if he saw these. Maybe I'll show them to him when I get home. Thank you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I got you a Phenny plushie. It's got an adorable apple motif, and I thought it was perfect for you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow, it's so cute! I didn't know they had this kind of Phenny design! Thank you, Ichika. I'm going to put it on my bed since it's so fluffy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A Phenny, I see! How perfect because my gift to you is these Phoenix Wonderland tickets. There are four of them, so do come with Saki and the others any time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know that you're working very hard with your band, but if you ever want to take a breather, we'll always be there to welcome you with open arms!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much! I've seen how much love and effort you and your troupe have put into your shows. I can't wait to come and watch them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, so next is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This feels...so nostalgic.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Now that I think about it, back then, whenever any of our birthdays came around, we always gathered at Saki's house like this.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm so happy that me, Saki, Ichika, and Shiho are able to talk like we used to...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You were spacing out just now... Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, yes. Sorry, everything is fine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was just thinking about how happy I am being able to celebrate with everyone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And on top of that, receiving all of these gifts... Thank you all so much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heh heh heh, it's way too soon to thank us, Honami! That's because I'm up next!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My gift to you is this! Ta-da!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is this...a portrait of me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I put a lot of effort into it. I think it's one of my best pieces!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mochizuki is surrounded by apple pies... Hehe, this portrait exudes just as much cheerfulness as you, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Look how happy Honami looks here!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Emu! Just looking at this portrait of me being surrounded by all of these apple pies makes me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but wait, there's more! There's actually one more gift for you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-da! A portrait from Ena♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is that...Honami?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, yes, it is. And look at her bashful smile! Ena's artwork is so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It really is. It's so intricate and captures Honami so well!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. Ena asked me to give you a birthday wish for her!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So from Ena, “Happy birthday, Honami!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you! This work of art is so beautiful it feels like a waste for me to have it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Looks like everyone has already given their presents! That means it is now time for my performance—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa! We're going to be playing games next, remember?
The next day
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki, I'm ready to begin...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm? Something smells really nice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Ms. Mochizuki. Welcome. This is...um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Were you making tea, Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um...yes. I knew that you were about to arrive soon, so I thought I'd practice brewing as much as I could beforehand...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Practice?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes... Here you are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't make it very well last time, but...I think I've gotten the hang of it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for everything, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I realized that it would've been better to do this after work, but since it's steeped nicely already, I'd like to celebrate now if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also... Please have this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, you shouldn't have! Did you get this apple pie for me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. Ena recommended me a nice shop.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She did? I see. Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The fact that you and even Ena have put in this much thought just for me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Even so, I didn't realize there were so many different kinds of apple pies.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wasn't sure what to get so I ended up buying a variety. Please eat as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you! I shall help myself.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it would be a shame for me to have this all to myself. Would you like to join me, Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you'd like me to have some?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In that case, I'll gladly take up your offer.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Great! I'll set up two plates.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, the recorder's ready. Let's get this done before Honami arrives home. Shiho, you're up first!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, happy birthday, Honami. We're always together so I don't really know what to say, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How did you like your gift this year? I kind of want to see how Shibao reacts so if you're free sometime, I'd like to see him again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'm up next!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Love you, Hona! Getting to spend every day with you is super fun♪ Let's perform shows and practice lots every single day until we can't anymore!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... It's me, Ichika. Happy birthday, Honami. Let's go stargazing again and do all sorts of other things together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello, this is Minori Hanasato! Happy birthday, Honami! Let's go out for a stroll with Samo together again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hello, it's Shizuku♪ Happy birthday, Honami! I hope you like the fluffy Shiba Inu socks. Please do wear them at home when the weather gets colder.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's Haruka. Minori and I went to pick out the hand cream together. Let's all go somewhere fun together sometime.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, then I'll go next... Um, it's Kohane. Happy birthday. If you don't mind, it would be great if you could recommend me some shops that have great apple pies.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hiii, it's Emu♪ Thank you for always helping me in class, Honami! If there's ever a time when you're feeling upset, I'll definitely be right there to turn that frown upside down☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well last but not least is me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Honami! I can truly see that you, Saki and the others have an even stronger bond than before! I know that things can get tough with your band activities but don't let it get you down!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, hello? I think it's recording... Ms. Mochizuki, thank you for always opening up to me and letting me do the same. I'm very indebted to your kindness, and I hope you have a wonderful year.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Honami. Did you receive the portrait? I think that was one of my best works; I hope you like it. Let's get together with Emu and paint on a big canvas, just the three of us sometime!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you all for your support and your birthday wishes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There are a lot of things I'm not very good at such as expressing my own opinion or even drawing, but thanks to all of you being there for me I've been able to muster my courage and work on them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It might not be much in comparison to other people, but I hope to change one step and a time.
